datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2015, classifying geographic units by food insecurity phase. The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions in Mauritania, aggregated into spatial features with classification scales and scenario information.
